title: Cosmic Eye Cavern
description: A massive surreal eye with a starry galaxy iris and glowing teal sclera floats in the center of an abstract cavern. Golden molten formations drip from the ceiling while layered rock strata in deep purple, turquoise, orange, and cracked stone form the surrounding environment.
prompt: Surreal fantasy cavern interior with a gigantic central eye floating in the middle. The eye has a deep space galaxy iris with stars and glowing turquoise sclera decorated with spiral symbols. Layered horizontal rock strata in deep purple, teal, and burnt orange. Dripping molten gold formations hang from the ceiling like stalactites. Cracked stone floor with gold veins. Dramatic god rays, ethereal atmosphere, intricate details.
